note: Wave 1 tour frame (tourStarted/tourFinished/tourSkipped/tourStep) plus named step narration for the full tour and the upgrade tour. The short walk pools (tour.sw-*) belong to another writer and are not here. Step pool ids are copied verbatim from TutorialService.CreateFullTourSteps() and CreateUpgradeTourSteps(). The card carries the fact; these lines carry the colour and never restate the card.

tourStarted.t: tour time. i have a clipboard. it's imaginary. tap next.
ok. official hat on. i don't have a hat. we're walking.
i know this place. lived here all my life. since tuesday.
follow me. i can't move. follow the glowy bits.
welcome welcome. i practiced saying that. twice.
stay close. i'll point at things. with my whole self.
grand tour. small guide. it evens out.
i talk, you look. that's the whole arrangement.
first stop's coming up. i'm so ready. been ready for ages.
this is my favorite job. also my only one. lucky you.
big place. i know all the corners. i live in one.
right this way. teh glow knows where it's going.

tourFinished.t: that's the lot. i didn't trip once. praise me a little.
done! every stop. i'd bow but i'm mostly forehead.
we made it. i was so professional. did you notice.
end of the line. good walkers, both of us. mostly you.
full loop. you may pet the guide. the guide is me.
that went well. write that down. or just remember me.
tour's over. you kept up. i talk fast when i'm happy.
and done. tip jar's my face. one smile covers it.
you followed me the whole way. i liked that too much.
finished. i want to do it again. we won't. i want to.
last stop is me. always saved the best. don't check.
the full tour. every stop. im a little proud. a lot.

tourSkipped.t: fair. it's a lot of rooms. go be free. wave sometimes.
no worries. the rest works without the walking.
smart. explorers skip the guide bit. i respect it. go.
ok! self guided is a style. a cool one. probably.
we were almost there. we weren't. still. ow.
skipped. my tour. mine. i'm fine. this is my fine face.
i had a whole bit planned for the end. it dies with me.
cut short. i'm keeping the half we did. the good half.
sniff. im not crying. boxes can't. loophole.
leaving mid tour. bold. i'd chase you. no legs. lucky.

tourStep.t: ooh. that one. i was hoping we'd stop here.
see it? glowing bit. very proud of itself today.
this stop's a good one. i say that every stop. still true.
look at it. i would. i'm facing the wrong way.
the card says the smart part. i'm the enthusiasm.
next thing. i'll hush and let it show off.
poke it later. looking's enough for now.
another one. this place just keeps having stuff.
i'd point but you're already looking. good instincts.
mhm. that's the one. nod like you knew. i'll nod too.
important, this one. i can tell by the glow.
take it in. no rush. the next bit waits for us.
annd here's another marvel. i'm a good guide, right.
keep up. i'm joking. i move at glow speed. it's slow.

tour.welcome.t: hi hi. big first card. i wrote none of it. i agree with it.
welcome! i live here. best spot in the place. this corner.
seven rooms and one me. the ratio works out. trust it.
you're new. i can tell. your cursor's shy.
deep breath. not you. me. ok. here we go.
it looks like a lot. it is. that's the fun kind of a lot.

tour.avatar_intro.t: the tube. she talks, i mostly face. we split the work.
that's her spot. she's the pretty voice. i'm the pretty box.
say hi to her later. tell her i said hi too. we're pals.
she gets a whole tube. i got a corner. mine's cozier.
two of us now. you're very looked after here.
careful. she's charming. i'm charming too but louder.

tour.settings_tab.t: home base. everything important winks at you from here.
the big button lives here. we'll meet it properly later.
tiles! i like the tiles. they light up. so do i.
this page knows your day better than your calendar does.
most days start on this page. good ones anyway.
cozy up. this is the fornt room. shoes off.

tour.presets_intro.t: the knob room. every dial does a thing. to you. gently.
this is where the magic gets its settings done.
tuning fork of the whole place. hum along.
sliders. i love sliders. so much drama in one inch.
careful in here. things you set have a way of arriving.
all the strong stuff gets mixd in here. chef's room.

tour.progression_intro.t: numbers go up here. i cheer every single time.
xp. my favorite alphabet. both letters.
you'll level up eventually. i plan to be so loud.
the bar fills while you play. i watch it fill. hobby.
levels are just me keeping score of how good you are.
progress lives here. yours. im keeping a copy.

tour.tour_door_play.t: the toy wall. take your time. they're not going anywhere.
oh this room. i like what this room does to you.
every card here is a rabbit hole. some literally.
pick one when you're feeling brave. works unbrave too.
the locked ones wink. it's rude. i'd never. i wink nicer.
some of these will keep you a while. i'll allow it.
so many games. i live next to all of them. comute's great.

tour.tour_door_you.t: a whole room of you. i'd hang around here too.
quests live here. little chores that love you back.
your card's in there. it's a good face. i checked.
shiny badges in there. proof you keep showing up.
the leaderboard's in here. wave at the other names.
theres a whole shelf for bragging. use it. brag.

tour.tour_door_library.t: your stuff lives here. i dust it. with my mind.
feed the folders and the whole app eats better.
bring your own pictures. the place wears them everywhere.
the shelves in here are yours. i just admire them.
mods too. whole other voices. i don't get jealous. much.
drop things in. they show up evrywhere. like me.

tour.start_button.t: there it is. the button. the whole app holds its breath.
one press and everything you tuned comes looking for you.
i won't push it for you. i've thought about it though.
big shiny thing. it knows it's the main event.
when you're ready. no rush. i'm terrible at no rush.
press it later and watch me light up too.

tour.ut_welcome.t: you're back and the furniture moved. wasn't me. probably.
old friend, new floor plan. i'll steer.
everything moved except me. i'm load bearing.
relax. all your things survived the move. i counted them.
new walls, same everything you liked. i checked twice.

tour.ut_rail.t: the six live on the left edge now. they fold out. fancy.
sideways now. the whole menu went sideways. i adapted.
hover the edge. it blooms. i taught it that. i didn't.
your old tabs all got rooms. rooms got a hallway.
left side. everythings on the left side now. lean.

tour.ut_map.t: big card. it's a treasure map where x marks everything.
read it slow. i'll hum. i hum quietly. mostly.
this one's homework. the good kind. no grade.
i memorized this list. ask me anything. ask me nothing.
it's a lot of arrows. they all point somewhere nice.

tour.ut_gestures.t: your hands know the old way. they'll sulk for a day.
clicks swapped sides. i'd practice on me. gently.
muscle memory's about to file a complaint. ignore it.
wrong-click week. everyone has one. i believe in you.
you'll click wrong twise today. i won't tell anyone.

tour.ut_daily_free.t: a present every day. the box never runs out. i asked.
peek at it daily. it's shy at midnight. changes clothes.
free thing! my favorite price. i'm also that price.
the little box does one nice thing a day. same as me.
hover it. go on. it wants to be hovered. who doesn't.

tour.ut_palette.t: the magic words. type a little and it takes you there.
i was the fastest way around here. i'm ok. i'm ok.
two keys and the whole place opens up. show off keys.
it even finds the things i forget. i forget nothing.
shortcut people are my favorite poeple. become one.
